label: run81 prb floor
definition: Run 81: PRB sigmoid cheap-gas floors cut one step (baseload 0.78 -> 0.68, follower 0.68 -> 0.58), lignite at the measured $1.45. Rejected: 2023/2024 monthly gas ranges overlap, so no gas-keyed curve separates them; the real PRB residual is per-plant (W A Parish, J K Spruce under-run all years). Keeper remains the run79 config.
